requirement: Pair ticks must be aligned by timestamp without lookahead.
Both legs must be entered and exited with equal fixed notional.
No passive fills, no maker rebate.
Both legs must use L1-L5 book state.
Levels 2-5 liquidity and imbalance gates required.
Rolling z-score and depth features must be known before entry.
Use Zerodha cost200 and fixed INR 1,000,000 capital.
Side-flip pair direction must not dominate primary.
Removing levels 2-5 must degrade or invalidate primary.
Pair result must not be explainable by one leg only.
Cost100 rank must not reverse acceptance ordering.
Synthetic result sign must be checked on real anchors if available.
No promotion, paper/live acceptance or deployable claim.
